HOW IT WORKS
How Firecrawl's free web extraction tools work:
1. Enter a URL

Paste the webpage or article link you want to process. No signup or API key required for the free tool.

2. We fetch and process

Firecrawl loads the page, extracts the content, and runs it through our pipeline in seconds.

3. Get your results

Download or copy the output. Ready to go further? Scale up with the API, MCP, or plugin.

WHO IS IT FOR
Who is Firecrawl for?

Firecrawl helps anyone who needs reliable, structured data from the web—without building and maintaining scrapers from scratch.

Developers

Integrate web data into your apps via API. Scrape, extract, and summarize at scale with a single SDK.

Researchers & analysts

Gather sources, citations, and links from many pages. Export clean data for reports and analysis.

Growth & marketing teams

Prospect research, lead lists, competitor intel, and content audits—all from live web data.

FAQ
Frequently asked questions
Are these Firecrawl tools really free?

Yes. Our all web data extraction tools listed here are free to use with no signup required. For high-volume, agentic, or automated use, check out the Firecrawl API.

Do I need an account?

No. You can use the free tools on this page without creating an account. Sign up when you're ready to use the API or playground.

What can I do with the Firecrawl API?

The API lets you scrape, extract, and summarize at scale: crawling, search, and more. Use our SDKs, integrate with your stack, or try the Playground.
